text: Review named a mutation my two C-10 tests could not see: json:"-" on SampledSpan.Reviewed drops every human verdict on disk while passing both in-memory tests and the pre-existing TestSamplesRoundTripThroughDisk, which asserts id, tool version and policy but never a verdict. I ran it: all three older tests pass under the mutation, only the new round-trip test fails.
